name: Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Helsinki, Porvoo and Vierumäki; six English bachelor's in business, IT, aviation, hospitality and sport.

ib.text: In the January joint application most places go on certificates, so your IB grades decide. Sports Coaching and blended International Business use entrance exams instead. You must also prove English.

dates.label: Joint application: certificates and proof of English due, 15:00
IB predicted grades due, 15:00 (so far stated only for Sports Coaching)
Rolling admission closes, 15:00 Finnish time, unless places fill first
IB Transcript of Grades due, 15:00 (so far stated only for Sports Coaching)

programmes.name: Degree Programme in Business Information Technology
Degree Programme in Digital Business Innovations
Degree Programme in International Business
programmes.ib: Full-time: IB grades. The blended-learning variant uses an entrance exam at Pasila (8–11 or 15–18 March 2027) instead.

programmes.name: Degree Programme in Hospitality and Tourism Experience Management
Degree Programme in Sports Coaching and Management
programmes.ib: Joint application only: advance assignment (published 7 Jan) due with your application by 21 Jan 2027, 15:00; online entrance interview 22–25 March.

notes: Five of the six degrees also take rolling applications, 30 Oct 2026 to 12 May 2027: the IB route needs 28 points, CAS, and an English IB or English at 4; predicted grades count.
In rolling admission you may apply to only one programme, and places go to complete, interviewed applicants in the order they applied.
Porvoo is about an hour from central Helsinki by public transport, and Vierumäki is a sports campus near Heinola.
